services.name: Texas Crappie Fishing Service
services.desc: I arrived at Lake LBJ at 6 am to get the boat ready and to catch some live bait with my cast net. I caught some spot tail minnows which we refer to as “special spot bait” with ease and got everything ready for the day’s Crappie fishing trip. At 7:30 am I met Tyler and his three kids Colton, Landyn and Case on Lake LBJ at Blue Briar Park in Granite Shoals, TX. The weather that morning was overcast with possible thunderstorms in the afternoon. The water temperature was 83 degrees and the air temperature was 72 degrees with light winds. blurb: Texas Crappie Fishing Service offers year-round guided crappie fishing on Lake Buchanan, Lake LBJ, and Lake Austin. Trips are family friendly and include all bait and gear. Half and full-day charters are available and can be customized.
